honest_deviations_and_observations.title: PHASE 6 B1: same-candidate value DECREASES after its own useful CONFIRMED outcome
honest_deviations_and_observations.detail: The TEAM-2 brief expected an increase. Runtime shows the production value function (compute_candidate_value) decreases it because a confirmed hypothesis is resolved — the evidence_relevance component (confidence<0.7 gate) is captured and dominates the +0.2 exploitation_value gain. The increase channels ARE proven: exploitation_value component increases (B3) and return-to-exploitation raises saturated-branch candidate value after a HIGH confirmed outcome (B2). Anti-redundancy by design; OutcomeTracker demonstrably affects future candidate value in both directions. NOT a trust boundary bypass.

Conservative behavior, not a bypass.
